result.edit: The test fails at cycle=3 with incorrect Gray code output (0010 vs expected 0011). The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where bin_out[1] and bin_out[0] incorrectly depend on previous bin_out values that haven't been updated yet in the same cycle. The fix replaces these dependencies with their equivalent expressions using only gray_wire bits, ensuring correct calculation of each bit independently.
